groups.title: Core

groups.title: Gameplay

groups.title: Presentation

groups.title: Systems

skills.title: roblox
skills.oneLiner: Architecture principles, cross-skill workflows, quick-reference patterns
skills.displayTitle: Roblox development hub: architecture and skill routing
skills.overview: Entry-point skill: server authority, client-server model, and a decision tree that routes to the right specialist. Load this first.
covers: The single entry point: overarching architecture and server-authority principles.
Quick-reference patterns and a decision tree that routes you to the right specialized skill.
Cross-skill workflows for data, UI, animation, monetization, and networking.

skills.title: roblox-core
skills.oneLiner: Services, Luau types, serialization, script locations, `RunContext`, the data model
skills.displayTitle: Roblox core services, Luau types, and RunContext
skills.overview: Services via `game:GetService`, Luau types, script locations, `RunContext`, and the client-server data model. The layer every other skill assumes.
covers: Every important service via `game:GetService`, Luau data types and serialization rules.
Script locations and execution contexts, including modern `BaseScript.RunContext`.
The client-server data model, and the reality that there is no runtime filesystem I/O.

skills.title: roblox-networking
skills.oneLiner: Remotes, server authority, network ownership, exploit defenses, capabilities
skills.displayTitle: Roblox networking: remotes, server authority, security
skills.overview: Remotes, network ownership, and server authority. Validation, rate limiting, and capability patterns that stop common exploits.
covers: RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction vs Bindable equivalents, and RunService execution contexts.
Server authority as the foundation: validation and rate-limiting on every request.
Common exploit vectors and capability-based access control.

skills.title: roblox-datastores
skills.oneLiner: DataStores, versioning, metadata, quotas, throttling, safe save/load patterns
skills.displayTitle: Roblox DataStores: safe saves, versioning, quotas
skills.overview: DataStore, OrderedDataStore, and MemoryStore: `UpdateAsync`, versioning, quotas, and save patterns that avoid data loss. Pair with roblox-networking.
covers: DataStore vs OrderedDataStore vs MemoryStore Service decision tree.
`UpdateAsync` with a pure transform for contended values; hourly versioning for recovery.
Every error code, quota, and throttling strategy, with patterns that avoid data loss.

skills.title: roblox-user-interfaces
skills.oneLiner: GUI containers, responsive layouts, interaction, particles-in-UI techniques
skills.displayTitle: Roblox UI: containers, responsive layouts, interaction
skills.overview: ScreenGui, SurfaceGui, BillboardGui, and building blocks. Scale+offset layouts, Activated vs mouse events, and particles-in-UI limits.
covers: Every GUI container (ScreenGui, SurfaceGui, BillboardGui) and building block.
Scale + offset responsive layouts tested across target screen sizes.
Particles-in-UI techniques, and the truth that 3D ParticleEmitters don't render in ViewportFrame.

skills.title: roblox-animation
skills.oneLiner: `Animator`, tracks, IK, `TweenService`, UI tweens, animation markers
skills.displayTitle: Roblox animation: Animator, IK, TweenService, markers
skills.overview: `Animator` / `AnimationTrack` / `IKControl` for characters; `TweenService` for UI and 3D. Replaces deprecated `Humanoid:LoadAnimation`.
covers: Animator-based loading with proper track lifecycle and marker-driven gameplay.
`IKControl` for procedural posing; CurveAnimation vs KeyframeSequence.
`TweenService` for UI and 3D, sequences, chaining, and typewriter effects.

skills.title: roblox-vfx
skills.oneLiner: `ParticleEmitter`, shapes, flipbooks, beams, trails, highlights, performance
skills.displayTitle: Roblox VFX: ParticleEmitter, Beam, Trail, performance
skills.overview: `ParticleEmitter`, `Beam`, `Trail`, `Highlight` - emission patterns, flipbooks, and LOD so effects don't tank FPS.
covers: ParticleEmitter properties, sequences, shapes, and flipbooks.
Beam, Trail, Highlight, plus one-shot vs continuous emission.
Performance: LOD-aware patterns that degrade gracefully on low-end devices.

skills.title: roblox-audio
skills.oneLiner: Modern audio graph (`AudioPlayer`/`AudioEmitter`/`Wire`/TTS/STT), legacy `Sound`, 3D audio, effects, performance
skills.displayTitle: Roblox audio: modern graph, legacy Sound, 3D, effects
skills.overview: Modern audio graph (`AudioPlayer`, `AudioEmitter`, `Wire`, TTS/STT) vs legacy `Sound`. 2D/3D, effects, and mobile caps.
covers: The modern modular audio graph: AudioPlayer, AudioEmitter, Wire, TTS, STT.
Legacy Sound/SoundGroup: discouraged for new work, and when to still use it.
2D vs 3D audio, effect chains, and mobile performance caps.

skills.title: roblox-gamepasses
skills.oneLiner: Game passes, dev products, subscriptions, purchase flow, policy, Robux transfers, analytics
skills.displayTitle: Roblox monetization: game passes, products, subscriptions
skills.overview: Game passes, developer products (`ProcessReceipt`), and subscriptions - server-side grants, idempotency, and current policy dates.
covers: Game passes, developer products (`ProcessReceipt`), and subscriptions.
Server-authoritative granting with idempotency guards and `PlayerAdded` re-verification.
Current policy: cross-experience sales disabled (May 30 2026); Creator Rewards replaced Premium Payouts.

skills.title: roblox-open-cloud
skills.oneLiner: Open Cloud REST APIs: API keys/OAuth2, data stores, assets, universes, webhooks, in-experience calling
skills.displayTitle: Roblox Open Cloud: REST APIs, keys, in-experience calls
skills.overview: Open Cloud REST APIs for data stores, assets, universes, and more. Keys, OAuth2, scopes, Secrets Store, and in-experience `HttpService`.
covers: REST APIs for data stores, assets, universes, and more, from outside the engine or in-experience via HttpService.
API keys, OAuth2, least-privilege scopes, and the 60-day key auto-expiry rule.
Secrets Store + `HttpService:GetSecret` so keys never sit in scripts.

skills.title: roblox-teleport
skills.oneLiner: `TeleportAsync`, `TeleportOptions`, reserved servers, multi-place, matchmaking, DataStore handoff
skills.overview: `TeleportAsync` (replaces legacy teleport methods), reserved servers, multi-place handoff, and spoofable teleport-data caveats.
covers: The unified `TeleportAsync` API that replaces the deprecated teleport methods.
`TeleportOptions`, reserved servers, and `TeleportAsyncResult` error handling.
Multi-place architecture, DataStore handoff, and matchmaking patterns.

skills.title: roblox-rojo
skills.oneLiner: Rojo 7: CLI/plugin, project format, live sync, build/upload, sourcemap, syncback
skills.displayTitle: Rojo: filesystem projects, live sync, build
skills.overview: Rojo 7 project workflows: install CLI/plugin, `.project.json`, live sync, build/upload, sourcemaps, and `syncback` for place→files.
covers: Install CLI + Studio plugin (Rokit, GitHub, cargo) and connect with `rojo serve`.
Project format, file→instance mapping (`.server.luau` / `.client.luau` / modules), meta files.
`rojo build` / `upload` / `sourcemap` / `syncback`; live-sync limits and two-way caveats.

skills.title: roblox-mcp
skills.oneLiner: Connect AI agents to Roblox Studio via MCP: setup, tools, Script Sync, playtesting
skills.displayTitle: Roblox Studio MCP: connect AI agents to Studio
skills.overview: Official Studio MCP server: read/write scripts, run Luau, playtest, capture viewport. Setup for Cursor, VS Code, Claude, Codex + Script Sync.
covers: Connect AI agents to Roblox Studio via the official MCP server.
Read and write scripts, explore the data model, run Luau, and capture the viewport.
Combine with Script Sync for a file-based workflow.

skills.title: roblox-physics
skills.oneLiner: Rigid bodies, assemblies, mechanical/mover constraints, network ownership, vehicles
skills.displayTitle: Roblox physics: assemblies, constraints, network ownership
skills.overview: Assemblies, welds, mechanical/mover constraints (replacing BodyMovers), network ownership for vehicles, and sleep/timestepping.
covers: Assemblies, root parts, anchoring, and WeldConstraint vs RigidConstraint.
Mechanical and mover constraints, the modern replacements for deprecated BodyMovers.
Network ownership for vehicles, the sleep system, and adaptive timestepping.

skills.title: roblox-npcs
skills.oneLiner: PathfindingService, modifiers/links, waypoint following, patrol/chase AI patterns
skills.displayTitle: Roblox NPCs: PathfindingService, AI patterns, patrol
skills.overview: `PathfindingService`, modifiers/links, and NPC patterns (state machines, patrol/chase) that scale.
covers: PathfindingService, agent parameters, and blocked-path handling.
PathfindingModifier and PathfindingLink, with material and region costs.
State machines, behavior trees, and patrol/chase patterns at scale.

skills.title: roblox-testing
skills.oneLiner: Developer Console, MicroProfiler, Scene Analysis, tests, logging, common bug fixes
skills.displayTitle: Roblox testing: Developer Console, MicroProfiler, TestEZ
skills.overview: Developer Console, MicroProfiler, Scene Analysis, TestEZ, and a method for isolating bugs and perf issues.
covers: Developer Console, Output discipline, and pcall/assert patterns.
MicroProfiler, Scene Analysis, and the Script Profiler.
TestEZ unit tests, memory diagnostics, and a methodology for isolating issues.
